title: Original Portal BusinessInput authority schema rejected three of four canonical portal record contracts
root_cause: Authenticated original portal-business-input-handler appends SourceObservation/raw_source, BusinessInput/SourceTruth, CurrentState/current_state and ImpactAssessment/organism_impact via brain-operating-authority and public.brain_append_record. Actual production public.brain_records CHECKs admit only canonical record_type and record_kind lists: these excluded three original Portal record pairs. RPC passes type/kind through unchanged. Existing mocked tests never validated live PostgreSQL CHECK lists.
impact: Potential RAW_SOURCE_WRITE_FAILED on every real authenticated portal data edit through this authority path; source and consumer cannot both be ACK_PROCESSED if first immutable source row is rejected. Actual affected end user sessions not independently counted. No claim of proven data loss.
fix: Preserve the originally authored semantic types and extend existing canonical type/kind CHECKs only for SourceObservation/raw_source, BusinessInput/SourceTruth and ImpactAssessment/organism_impact, transactionally validate existing rows; leave CurrentState/current_state and all original type/kinds unchanged. Same original protected Supabase GitOps/Brain authority, no second store, RLS grant or tenant bypass.
prevention_rule: Compare every actual original Portal→Brain typed record to live provider pg_get_constraintdef and original source schema under protected CI. Refuse saved/full-green when any required pair cannot be stored. Tenant-scoped provider schema readback and processed consumer ACK are separate; never infer outcomes from source migration.
owner: Original Portal V2 P0 #4215; existing agent-data-quality / existing Supabase protected migration + ONE BRAIN source consumer
evidence: Read-only production pg_get_constraintdef on 2026-11-13: brain_records_type_check excludes SourceObservation, BusinessInput, ImpactAssessment; brain_records_kind_check excludes raw_source, SourceTruth, organism_impact
Read-only production public.brain_append_record body passes p_record_type/p_record_kind straight to public.brain_records without conversion
Original server source platform/api/portal-business-input-handler.mjs and platform/organism/change-propagation.mjs emit exact four pairs; original mocked tests only assert in-memory append calls
status_boundary: SOURCE_MIGRATION_CANDIDATE; provider schema not changed by PR; protected Required/BRAIN/CodeQL and native Supabase GitOps exact-version migration apply + independent pg_get_constraintdef verification EVIDENCE_DUE. Real tenant two-user readback, original processed consumer ACK, Heartbeat/Powerhouse, CRO treatment and measured outcomes remain independently EVIDENCE_DUE.
